name: Thotar
summary: In Razor Hill, Thotar teaches young Horde hunters the ways of tracking and taming beasts. He trains orcs and trolls who have left the Valley of Trials to face Durotar’s wildlife.

sections.title: A Mentor in Razor Hill
sections.body: In Razor Hill, Thotar trains Horde hunters for the wilderness of Durotar. New recruits learn the basics in the Valley of Trials, then come to him as they face more dangerous predators. He teaches marksmanship and the respect needed to live alongside and direct Kalimdor’s deadliest creatures, drawing on traditions passed down through generations of orcs.

sections.title: Taming the Wilds
sections.body: Thotar guides young hunters through the ancient art of taming beasts. He sends them into arid canyons to calm and bond with native creatures, including venomous scorpids, armored surf crawlers, and cunning boars. His instruction teaches Horde trackers to build a bond with nature rather than rely on force.

faq.answer: Thotar trains hunters in Razor Hill, teaching traditional wilderness lore, marksmanship, and beast taming.
Thotar can be found in Razor Hill, the Horde settlement in central Durotar, just north of the Valley of Trials.
Thotar teaches hunting and tracking traditions passed down through generations of orcs. He emphasizes weapon mastery, wilderness survival, and patient bonding with animal companions.
Thotar trains hunters aligned with the Horde who come to Razor Hill. He mentors Darkspear trolls and wandering tauren passing through Durotar.

faq.q: What tasks does Thotar give to young hunters?
aliases: what does thotar send you to do
faq.answer: Thotar sends novice hunters to track native Durotar wildlife, including boars, surf crawlers, and scorpids. They use a taming rod to earn the beasts’ trust and obedience.

faq.q: Why is beast taming so important in his training?
faq.answer: A beast companion can help a Horde hunter survive in battle and in the wild. Thotar teaches hunters to bond with their beasts so they become loyal defenders of the Horde.

angles.text: As a Horde hunter, you learn the rites of beast taming and wilderness skills after leaving the starter valleys.
As an orc, you follow Thotar’s traditional hunting customs and ancestral respect for tracking and beast companionship.
As a Darkspear hunter leaving Sen’jin Village, you learn Horde survival skills for the dangers of Durotar.
As a member of the Horde, you can learn from Thotar in Razor Hill to patrol Durotar’s borders with sharp eyes and a well-bonded combat beast.
